method.quality: First 50 examples of each task; same prompt hashes, five-shot GSM8K, zero-shot IFEval.
method.retrieval: 18 unique fixtures: 8192/16384 tokens, start/middle/near-end, single/pair/revision tasks.
method.timing: Correctness only. Baseline and native-512 processes overlapped; do not compare their wall times.

limitations: These are paired 50-example quality samples, not complete benchmarks.
A small fixed retrieval set is not a general long-context accuracy estimate.
Full evaluator JSON/JSONL outputs are retained in the local results directory.

fixtures.system: Use the records to answer the question. Follow the requested output format exactly.

decision.reason: Retain the tested default: native candidates improved the small IFEval sample but lost GSM8K items; native 2048 also failed two varied retrieval cases. This sample is not a conclusive general quality comparison.
